title: Sri Mariamman Temple, Singapore
representedDate: Present temple with the five-tier street tower and the 2023 conservation work.
geometryBasis: Native temple outline, separately mapped street gate, compound walls, western shrine wraps and attached ranges.
sectionBasis: Original terrain from the exact entrance. Five-tier gopuram proportions estimated from the exact public-domain drawing and mapped floor width. Temple descriptions establish timber doors, trefoil hall bays, four western vimanam and cattle figures along the boundary.
limitations: Tower and shrine heights, vivid paint tones and simplified sculptural groups are estimates. The figures represent architectural mass and placement. Individual sculptures and historic murals are not reproduced.
The main hall, street wall and mapped secondary structures are represented as exterior volumes. Some roof edges and courtyard arrangements are inferred from the available survey.
